capacity_note: Whole venue: 270 seated dinner, 400 standing cocktail, 342 theatre-style ceremony seats. Amplified music ends 9:30pm; bump-out can continue later.
price_note: Full-venue hire from $3,300 + GST with a $500-$1,000 bond; dance-floor flooring in The Gantry is $500 + GST extra. No wedding package; you choose your own caterer, celebrant, florist and styling.
editorial_summary: An 890 square metre open-plan warehouse complex whose main hall has a tall ceiling and a mezzanine, hired as a blank canvas for ceremony and reception in one place. Couples bring their own caterer, styling and music, with a full kitchen on site. Amplified music has to stop by 9:30pm.

address: 189B St Johns Road, Forest Lodge NSW 2037
capacity_note: The Deep about 140 guests, The Greenhouse about 44, both together 183; seated/standing split not stated. Hire runs 7am-9pm (setup from 6am).
price_note: The Deep for weddings 1,000 half day / 2,000 full day; The Greenhouse 400 / 700; both 1,500 / 2,600 (currency not stated, weekend minimum 4 hours). Cleaning and extra fees may apply.
editorial_summary: A converted industrial studio with a large concrete-floored hall and a smaller light-filled greenhouse room, plus an outdoor deck, run as a non-profit. Outside caterers and BYO food and drink are welcome, so it suits a hands-on, budget-conscious wedding of up to about 180 guests.

capacity_note: Capacity, ceremony rules and pricing not published; private hire is offered seven days a week.
editorial_summary: A gin distillery and bar in a reimagined mechanic's workshop, with a terrazzo bar and copper still, taking private hire for weddings, engagements and masterclasses. A vintage Kombi mobile bar can also travel to other NSW wedding venues. Capacity and prices are quote-only.

capacity_note: Ceremony on Biloela Lawn: 100 guests (FAQ; venue guide says 200 standing). Indoor halls: Turbine Shop 850 seated / 2,000 cocktail; Naval Store 150 seated / 200 cocktail. Wedding bookings on the lawn must be paired with a reception at one of the island's two cafes.
price_note: Price on application. Ceremony hire is a 2-hour exclusive slot; no catering at the ceremony and only one celebratory drink per guest, supplied by the couple.
editorial_summary: A heritage island in the harbour with old shipyard workshops, cranes and sandstone. Wedding ceremonies are held on Biloela Lawn for up to about 100 guests, with a reception at one of the island's cafes, while the large industrial halls are hired as dry spaces for bigger events. Reached by ferry, with no street address.

capacity_note: Spaces range from Elston Room (150 banquet, 300 standing) and Bay 21 (250 banquet, 300 cocktail) to Bays 22-24 (1,500 banquet, 3,600 standing).
price_note: No prices published; quoted from a production schedule. Exclusive catering panel applies (BYO caterer not stated).
editorial_summary: A big 19th-century railway workshop complex turned arts centre, with raw brick bays, apex ceilings and polished concrete halls that couples have used for weddings and receptions. Best for large guest lists and heavy styling; the venue works from an exclusive caterer panel and quotes each event individually.

capacity_note: 3,500 square metre hall with 12m ceilings; page lists 1,250 banquet / 2,500 cocktail but also says use is currently capped at 500 people. Treat 500 as the limit until confirmed.
price_note: Rate card published as a PDF; not read. Hire is limited to non-ship days.
editorial_summary: A vast industrial-chic waterfront terminal with 12 metre ceilings and city views, hired as an empty shell for galas and large events and, per wedding guides, occasionally weddings. Couples bring in all catering, styling and production. Current hire is capped at 500 people.
A restored warehouse at The Cannery with exposed timber beams, raw brickwork and concrete floors under high ceilings.
The Olio room sits on the second floor of the restored Old Rum Store, with exposed brick walls, arched windows and light oak floors.
A space in an old CBD building whose standout feature is its exposed historic brickwork.
A former industrial site mixing warehouse spaces with lush planting across the Atrium, the Garden and Linseed House.
The SoHo and Loft rooms are New York-style lofts on a heritage wharf, with exposed brick, floor-to-ceiling windows and a wraparound deck; SoHo holds up to 80 seated or 100 cocktail.
A repurposed historic warehouse with exposed brick, high ceilings and plenty of daylight, run by an anti-slavery organisation.
